caption:
Thankful ❤️❤️

During my gymnastics journey to the Olympics, I had the chance to meet and work with so many amazing people who supported me, gave me advice, helped me through adversity, made me laugh and pushed me to be the best person and athlete I can be. They were significantly always by my side no matter what (wins, fails, highs, lows, injuries… ) and I couldn’t have done it without my coaches, support staff, family, friends and teammates 🫶🏻

I have received an overwhelming amount of support, and I am very grateful to be able to share my journey with them. 

I’m training to improve as much as I can for the Olympics, and I know that I’ve got a strong team by my side to help me through everything, no matter the outcome. 

Shout-out to @excellence.repentigny and @fondationaleo that gave me financial support and resources to help me reach my goals.

athlete.bio: A relentless competitor with a flair for creativity, this versatile athlete dazzles on the field. Known for strategic play and infectious enthusiasm, they inspire teammates and fans alike while pursuing excellence.

caption:
This year has been a rollercoaster. Taking a year off from school to focus on gymnastics was a struggle for me initially, and being faced with two separate ankle injuries made this journey even more difficult. However, in the past few months, I feel like the fire for my love of gymnastics has been reignited. 

I love all of the opportunities I get the chance to take up and all the wonderful people I get to meet through gymnastics. I was really proud of how I improved at every meet leading up to Trials and hit 8/8 there. 

I am honoured to say I am the second travelling alternate for the Olympic team. While I won’t get the chance to compete on that world stage, I couldn’t be more proud to get to support my teammates in Paris. 

Thank you to everyone who has supported me throughout this entire year: my parents, coaches, teammates, friends, IST, and so many others. I wouldn’t get to receive this honour without you all ❤️🇨🇦

caption:
Yesterday was a big day for me. I was fully cleared to play football again after 18 months of rehab. I suffered a bad knee injury that put my athletic future at risk. I couldn’t accept the fact I was done after just starting my college career. I worked hard every day no matter what, but most importantly I found and kept my faith in God! Thank you God for giving me a second chance and for healing me. This journey helped me find my path both as a person and a player. Even though this journey felt like hell at times I see why I had to go through it. Those close to me know just how hard this was on me both physically and mentally. Thank you to my all my doctors and trainers that helped me come back! Time to get after it!

Proverbs 24:16 “For though a righteous man may fall seven times, he still gets up; but the wicked stumble in bad times.”

caption:
Words cannot explain how proud I am of this young man. @mason.woods19 has shown all season what it means to be a competitor, but today, he reminded us what it means to be a champion.

Going into his state winning jump sitting in 3rd place, Mason looked me in the eye and said, “I didn’t come here to get 3rd again.” My response? “Then don’t.”

And just like that; the rest was history.

This wasn’t just a win on the scoreboard. It was a win for technique session, every tough workout, and every moment he chose grit over comfort.

Congratulations! You earned every inch of that jump, and every bit of this moment. Mason, you are the new school record holder in the long jump and better yet, a STATE CHAMPION‼️

Let this be a reminder: the heart of a true competitor doesn’t settle—it rises.

📸: @iconicmediaiowa

🇪🇸💯 Álvaro Folgueiras sigue firmando un año sobresaliente en la NCAA. Su última exhibición la ha firmado frente a Northern Kentucky Norse en un partido que su equipo llegó a perder por dobles dígitos y que, de su mano, dieron la vuelta en la segunda mitad.

El jugador español se fue hasta los 35 puntos, su mejor partido en la NCAA, con unos porcentajes excelentes de 12 de 14 en tiros de campo con 3 de 4 en triples a los que añadir 10 rebotes para lograr un doble-doble. Es su tercer doble-doble en los últimos 20 días y se quedó a tan solo un punto del récord anotador de un español en la NCAA (36, Francis Alonso).

caption:
🚨 OMS NIL CLIENT SIGNING 🚨 We are thrilled to announce the addition of one of the best shooters in college basketball in Brendan Hausen @brendanhausen to the OMS NIL Family! 

Brendan is a 6’4” Shooting Guard from Amarillo, Texas. He just spent this past season as a starter at Kansas State where he was one of the best 3 point shooters in all of the Big 12. His 90 3 pointers made on the year ranked 3rd in the conference and his 38.8% clip ranked 4th! 

On the year, Brendan averaged 10.9 points and 2.5 rebounds per game. His first two seasons, he played at Villanova University where he became known as one of the better pure shooters in the country! 

Brendan entered the transfer portal earlier today and we can’t wait to see what is next for him in his career and excited to be a part of it! Welcome to OMS, B! #OMS #OMSNIL #BrendanHausen #OMSFamily

caption:
After a lot of prayer, reflection, and conversations with those closest to me, I’ve officially decided to enter the transfer portal.

These past two years at Boise State have meant more to me than words can express. I am beyond grateful for every moment, every lesson, every teammate, and every opportunity that came my way. Boise became home, and this program shaped me, not just as an athlete, but as a person as well.

To my coaches, trainers, teammates, and the entire Bronco community—thank you from the bottom of my heart. You welcomed a girl from Oklahoma and gave her a place to learn, compete, and grow. I’ll always carry these memories with me.

Most importantly, I thank God for leading me through this journey and placing me exactly where I needed to be these last two years. His plan is greater than mine, and I trust Him as I take this next step.

I’m excited for what’s ahead and open to wherever this journey leads. With faith, gratitude, and a full heart

All glory to God💙

caption:
Thank you volleyball. 

I don’t usually write things like this, but this one just felt right.

To Miami.
Thank you for giving me my start and showing me what college volleyball and college life actually look like. Thank you for the lessons I didn’t even realize I was learning at the time. There were moments here when I felt like giving up on volleyball. I couldn’t imagine anything making me love the sport again. Thank you Miami, for building me to be the strongest I’ve ever had to be. You taught me resilience, patience, and how to keep believing in myself even when it was the hardest thing to do. I found a way forward, because there is always a way. No matter what. To the awesome staff, fans and the girls at Miami, thank you for everything. You will always have a place in my heart. Forever a Cane 🧡💚

To Iowa.
Oh my, what a place. Thank you for changing my life and truly lighting a spark in me that I’ll never forget. To the coaches, the girls, the entire staff, and the fans, thank you for believing in me and for building such amazing confidence in myself. Thank you for allowing me to find the love I had for the sport when I was a little girl playing volleyball in the backyard with my sisters. Thank you for allowing me to take that chance on myself and turning it into something I never could have imagined. I definitely hit the lottery on this one.  Ending this chapter here just feels right. Forever a Hawk 💛

If you ever get the opportunity to play college volleyball, take it. And if there isn’t, make it one. Promise it will be the best thing you do! 

Life doesn’t always go the way you think it will. Sometimes (actually most of the time lol) you have no idea where it’s taking you. But if you keep finding a way forward, you’ll end up right where you are suppose to be. 

Okay, this is long and people are probably scrolling, so I’ll end it here.

Trust God.
Trust the process.
Trust the people who really care.
And trust yourself.

Can’t wait to see where this next wave takes me 🤍

With all my love,
Mo

I am excited to announce my commitment to study and play football on a full scholarship at the university of Iowa.

Firstly I would like to thank @prokickaustralia @johnnypka_ and @tgpunting for making this opportunity possible with their coaching and hard work behind the scenes. Thank you also to Coach @levarwoods for believing in my ability and coming to visit my parents and I.

I would also like to thank the guys at @cqathleticperformance and @thehunt.sc for helping me along the way in my journey.

And finally, I would also like to thank my parents for their love and support and for also believing in me and for providing me with the opportunity to start punting in the first place.

With all that being said, I am excited to get to work.

athlete.bio: A fierce competitor with an unyielding spirit, she blends grace and power seamlessly. Hailing from a vibrant community, her infectious energy uplifts teammates, while her strategic acumen transforms challenges into triumphs.

caption:
Yo Soy Boricua. 

Being Puerto Rican is something I carry in my heart and no amount of words can truly describe the feeling. The pride I feel when I see my flag, the emotions that arise when I hear the music, and the deep connection I have when I embrace my culture. Our history, voices, and rhythms carry so much love, struggle and resiliency. Every song I hear reminds me of how powerful it is to love where you come from. 

Choosing my floor music for my collegiate routines was more than just choreography, it was about expressing my identity. Choosing songs like Preciosa by Marc Anthony, Alocate by Zion, Safaera by Bad Bunny, and Pa’Que Retozen by Tego Calderón was my way of carrying Puerto Rico with me in every floor routine I competed. 

These songs reminded me of where I come from, and who I represent when I compete. To be Puerto Rican is a blessing I don’t take lightly. In times like these when this country feels divided and uncertain, embracing my culture, keeps me proud and driven. 

Remember to always love who you are, where you come from, and to respect the cultural roots of others! 

WEPA! 🇵🇷

цей момент настав і я переходжу в інший клуб та роблю цей пост для пам‘яті про вас, бо буду дуже за вами сумувати і продовжувати любити❤️‍🩹
надіюсь на нашу зустріч у найблищий час❤️
про це я ніколи не забуду, бо це мій перший клуб, ВИ НАЗАВЖДИ В МОЄМУ СЕРЦІ❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥
також я часто згадую 2019,2020 і 2021 роки, коли я тільки почала приїжджати на тренування і познайомилася зі своєю новою напарницею на той час @_yanchik.13_  і ми грали разом три роки, потім вперше поїхала з вами на міжнародний турнір в Угорщину, на наступний рік мене заявили на Дитячу Лігу, потім на мій останній сезон в цьому клубі до заявили і на Першу Лігу🥺 
почалась війна…ми так і не встигли дограти цей сезон разом💔
я вас дуже сильно люблю і буду за вами сумувати❤️‍🩹
Бажаю вам всього найкращого і щоб ви вперто йшли до своєї мети та завжди були щасливими і здоровими❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥
також хочу побажати тренерам Миколі Вололимировичу Столярському і Роману Михайловичу Хомину залишатись такими хорошими тренерами і чудовими людьми, щоб були здоровими і щасливими❤️
я вам дуже вдячна за вашу працю і підтримку! 
дуже вам дякую, я вас дуже сильно люблю і буду за вами сумувати💔

caption:
PSA is proud to announce the signing of Tory Bennett to a marketing representation agreement!

Tory was a standout athlete in high school, excelling in multiple sports. She earned five All-Conference honors in softball (four times on the 1st team) and three All-State honors (including one 1st team selection). In 2021, she was named to the State Softball All-Tournament Team and helped her team win the state championship. In basketball, she earned three All-Conference honors and was named 3rd team All-State as a senior. Tory made school history by becoming the first player to achieve 300 points, 100 rebounds, and 100 assists in a single season. She holds the school records for both career and single-season assists and was a member of the All-Star series as a senior. Additionally, she participated in volleyball and track, qualifying for the state track meet in 2021.

As a freshman at Iowa Tory started all 62 games at shortstop, finishing with a .303 batting average, 61 hits, 12 doubles, and one triple. She had 18 multi-hit games and six multi-RBI games. As a sophomore in 2024, she started in 37 games, finishing with a .265 batting average and a .351 on-base percentage. She recorded 31 hits, six doubles, and 13 RBIs, with six multi-hit games. Tory was also recognized as an Academic All-Big Ten Honoree.

We can’t wait to help her with all of her off the field NIL needs! Welcome to the team @tbenny02
#Hawkeyes

caption: As my club career comes to an end I am filled with an overwhelming sense of gratitude, for this sport and the people I have found through it. There are no words to express how thankful I am towards each and every person who has supported me, my coaches, my teammates, my family and friends you are truly my rock and I couldn’t have achieved any of my dreams without you. A special thank you to everyone @bartconnergymnastics for your unwavering confidence in me as a gymnastics and as a human being I’m going to miss y’all so much. These past few years have come with adversity and obstacles, that led me to my faith, and built my character in ways I couldn’t imagine. I learned to trust in Gods plan and that he has a purpose for me that is much bigger than just gymnastics, every success is through his glory and his glory alone. I can’t wait to experience this next chapter he has for me in Iowa City, so ready to be a Hawkeye and live out my childhood dream of being a collegiate gymnast. GO HAWKS💛🖤💛🖤

caption:
Thank you to my teammates and staff that stepped forward & spoke up. And a big thank you to the University of Iowa for taking the necessary steps to insure we have a safe & respectful training environment.

This year has taken a toll on me mentally, emotionally and physically. From the weight of almost losing myself entirely to doubting my ability to even continue gymnastics. Though from the outside looking in and statistically, it looked like I had my best season yet, but at what cost? 

This sport has taught me so much throughout the year, but I’m especially thankful for the resiliency it has taught me because it is what has gotten me through this difficult time. I love being a Hawkeye and I’m so grateful to have met such a strong group of ladies to call teammates & friends. I’m also grateful to the Assistant Coaches & staff for helping me keep my passion for gymnastics during the hard days. I cannot wait for the fresh start & look forward to next season with this amazing team. 
#ProudToBeAHawkeye🖤💛

caption:
My senior club season has officially come to an end, and looking back on this journey feels so bittersweet. There were times when the setbacks were heavy, my doubts were loud, and my progress felt slow. I started out my first three years as the girl who never even qualified for nationals. I remember watching other girls qualify and wonder if that would ever be me. Now I close this chapter as a national bars champion and 3rd in the all-around. But beyond the medals, the rankings, and the routines, this season was something so much deeper. It was the result of years of quiet, unseen effort. 
Gymnastics has pushed me further than I ever thought I could go. It’s broken me down and built me back up more times than I can count. It’s taught me to fall with and keep fighting even when the odds weren’t in my favor. Turn my failure into fuel. It showed me what I’m made of, not just as an athlete, but as a person. My journey has showed me that nothing is ever over. 
There were times I questioned if all the effort would ever pay off. But through it all I knew my heavenly father was there. When I felt stuck or defeated, I was reminded that i’m a part of a way bigger plan than I know. He gave me the strength to keep going, the peace to keep believing, and the purpose to keep competing, not for perfection, but because I get to share my gift with others. 
To my coaches—thank you for pushing me to be my best and believing in me even when I couldn’t see it. Thank you for putting up with my constant need of reassurance. To my teammates—thank you for constantly being there for me and for becoming my absolute best friends. To my family—thank you for your unconditional love and support. Thank you for the endless amounts of sacrifices you have made. To my future coaches- thank you for believing in me from the start and trusting me. To coach Christian - thank you for giving me the recourses and time to get stronger. And to my Heavenly Father—thank You for being with me in every moment, the ups and the downs. This may be the end of my club journey but i’m not done. This is just the beginning. I’m so excited to compete for The University of Iowa. There’s so much to learn, give and become

caption:
Caitlin Clark made a shot from this spot to break the all time D1 points leader record. When I visited Iowa, I told the Iowa coaches that if I made the famous Caitlin Clark shot, I would commit to Iowa. 

I’m excited to announce that I have accepted a full ride athletic scholarship to Iowa! I want to thank all the schools and coaches that I have talked with and visited with over the last couple months. I’m grateful for all the opportunities that have been offered. This was the hardest decision to make. I have learned so much about myself and life with this experience. I value loyalty, and Jen Llewellyn has been there for me since I was recruitable and believed in my talent. I’m excited to see what the future holds for Iowa.  I know we are going to break records and I can’t wait to be a Hawkeye! 
I want to thank my family, coaches, teammates, friends, and my Heavenly Father. They have been there to support me through this unexpected process. 
Let’s go make some history!

#imnotdone #Youbreakityouownit #gymnastics #ncaagymnastics #commited #iowa #iowagymnastics
